entities.name: Jérémy Lauzon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jérémy Lauzon is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL). Lauzon was drafted by the Boston Bruins in the second round, 52nd overall, in the 2015 NHL entry draft.
